title: Catalog
description: A catalog containing categories, items, availability, and fulfillment configuration.

category_ids.description: Ordered top-level category identifiers included in this catalog. Nested categories use parent_category_id and child_category_ids.

item_ids.description: Ordered item identifiers included in this catalog that are not assigned to a category.

availability.description: Catalog availability. When present, it overrides item availability.

fulfillment_modes.description: Fulfillment modes supported by this catalog.

metadata.description: Business-defined custom data extending the catalog.
